newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,154 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,154 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,154 contracts compared with 1,730 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 52 wheat, 669 corn, 343 soybean, 16 soymeal, 71 soyoil, one oat and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was two to 3-1/2 cents lower, corn was 1-3/4 to 3-3/4 cents lower and soybeans were 4-3/4 to 3/4 cents lower.
